thread:
Aisha: Quick heads-up — we're coordinating a co-hosted webinar + booth demo for the Scale & Serve roadshow with AWS Marketplace, NVIDIA (hw partner), and Accelera SI. Proposed date Apr 25 (2 weeks). Need to lock speakers, the demo owner, and swag plan. Who can own what?

Luca: I can book the booth and cross-check space. Need final speaker list + AV needs by Apr 10. @Maya can you confirm landing page timeline? :calendar:

Maya: Yep — marketing can build a co-branded page. Need partner logos (SVG), speaker headshots, and 1-line bios by Apr 12. Swag budget? Thinking: stickers, a lapel pin, and a small tech sticker pack. Thoughts? :tada:

Priya: Solutions will run the customer case study and SI partner segment. I'll coordinate with Accelera to get a customer on the panel. Can take lead on the dry-run. Demo owner needs to sign off on data/synthetic dataset.

Sam: From product: demo must use synthetic customer data + be reproducible on a 2-card setup. Also want to show automatic fallback: hosted -> dedicated -> private routing in the demo. I'll own the routing slide and failover snippet.

Aisha: Great. @Sam can you draft a 5-slide tech overview? Priya, can you confirm Accelera's rep this week? Luca — AV specifics: we need HDMI + USB-C, two mics, and a display for live demo.

Elena: Logistics: I can handle swag shipping and on-site helpers. Send me weights/dimensions. If NVIDIA is sending dev kits, I need the courier name + customs docs by Apr 15.

Maya: Marketing ask: 1) co-branded social copy 2) email invite template 3) landing page. I'll create templates but need partner approvals. Budget: ~$3k for swag production + printing. Approve? :money_with_wings:

Aisha: Approve budget for swag up to $3k. Keep receipts in procurement channel.

Priya: Accelera confirmed lead: Rohan Patel (SI). He can speak to the integration timeline and run a short segment.

Aisha: Perfect. NVIDIA (Ken) offered two dev kits for the booth and can do a 10-min deep dive on quantized inference on Triton. We'll slot that as the main demo.

Luca: Draft run-of-show (will refine):
```
10:00 - 10:05 Intro (Aisha)
10:05 - 10:20 Partner keynote (AWS rep)
10:20 - 10:30 Hardware demo (NVIDIA - Ken)
10:30 - 10:40 SI customer case (Priya + Rohan)
10:40 - 10:55 Live end-to-end demo (Sam + Ken)
10:55 - 11:00 Q&A + CTAs
```

Maya: Suggest adding a 15-min dry-run 48 hrs before. Also want a short 1-min teaser video — need footage from demo folks by Apr 18.

Sam: I'll prep a minimal reproducible script and a docker command for the booth machines. Example snippet I'll bring:
```
# run minimal demo
docker run --gpus all redwood/demo:latest 
--model redwood-3b-quant --host 0.0.0.0 --port 8080
```

Elena: Action items list (assign):
- Speaker confirm: Aisha (owners: Aisha + Priya)
- Landing page + assets: Maya (due Apr 12)
- Swag production: Maya + Elena (budget approved)
- Dev kit shipping/customs: Elena (needs partner courier + docs by Apr 15)
- Dry-run: All (Apr 23)
- Run-of-show + slides: Sam + Priya + Ken (draft Apr 18)

partner-ops-bot: Reminder: partner asset checklist due in 7 days — logos, headshots, speaker bios.

Aisha: Can everyone confirm owners in thread? If no objections, I'll start partner comms and lock the date today. :rocket:

Maya: Confirmed on assets and landing page.

Luca: Confirmed on booth booking/AV.

Priya: Confirmed on case study + dry-run.

Sam: Confirmed — I'll bring the demo script + Docker image.

Elena: Confirmed on logistics & shipping.

Aisha: Awesome — I'll send a partner sync calendar invite and a shared Google folder with deadlines. Adding short checklist below for partners to sign off:
- logos (svg)
- headshots (300x300)
- bio (30-40 words)
- demo artifact (docker image + runbook)
- swag approval (final art)

Aisha: Thanks team — will loop in AWS/Ken/Rohan with this plan and ask for speaker confirmations by EOD tomorrow. :email:
